cases.text:
Known exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), fix these first:
- CVE-2023-4863: Google Chromium WebP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (added 2023-09-13; ransomware use: Unknown)

Dependency upgrade notes (scanner targets, cross-checked with OSV.dev):
- certifi 2022.12.7 → 2023.7.22: fixes certifi@2022.12.7 (CVE-2023-37920). OSV.dev confirms 1 of these.
- django 4.2 → 4.2.15: fixes django@4.2 (CVE-2024-42005). OSV.dev confirms 1 of these.
- pillow 9.4.0 → 10.0.1: MAJOR version change (9.x → 10.x), check for breaking API changes. Fixes pillow@9.4.0 (CVE-2023-4863). OSV.dev confirms 1 of these. OSV.dev lists no fix within 9.x (fixed in 10.0.0 to 12.3.0), so no compatible version bump resolves this.
- pyyaml 5.1 → 5.4: fixes pyyaml@5.1 (CVE-2020-14343). OSV.dev confirms 1 of these.
- urllib3 1.26.9 → 2.6.0: MAJOR version change (1.x → 2.x), check for breaking API changes. Fixes urllib3@1.26.9 (CVE-2023-43804, CVE-2025-66418). OSV.dev confirms 2 of these. OSV.dev lists a fix within 1.x for 3 of its 10 vulnerabilities in urllib3 1.26.9: urllib3 1.26.19 resolves those without a major version change; the rest have no fix within 1.x (fixed in 2.5.0 to 2.8.0).
